``` {r}
# read peaks files and convert to GRanges
# CTL Peaks
AUT.peaks <- read.table("anti-CTCF.INTS1-aux_1_frag.bedgraph", sep="\t")[,1:3]
BUT.peaks <- read.table("anti-CTCF.INTS1-aux_2_frag.bedgraph", sep="\t")[,1:3]
#CUT.peaks <- read.table("anti-CTCF.INTS1-aux_3_frag.bedgraph", sep="\t")[,1:3]
colnames(AUT.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(BUT.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
#colnames(CUT.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
AUT.peaks <- GRanges(AUT.peaks)
BUT.peaks <- GRanges(BUT.peaks)
#CUT.peaks <- GRanges(CUT.peaks)
#UT.peaks <- intersect(intersect(AUT.peaks, BUT.peaks), CUT.peaks)
UT.peaks <- intersect(AUT.peaks, BUT.peaks)

# INTS11 Peaks
AINTS11.peaks <- read.table("anti-CTCF.INTS11+aux_1_frag.bedgraph", sep="\t")[,1:3]
BINTS11.peaks <- read.table("anti-CTCF.INTS11+aux_2_frag.bedgraph", sep="\t")[,1:3]

colnames(AINTS11.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(BINTS11.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")

AINTS11.peaks <- GRanges(AINTS11.peaks)
BINTS11.peaks <- GRanges(BINTS11.peaks)

MINTS11.peaks <- intersect(AINTS11.peaks, BINTS11.peaks)

# INTS1 Peaks
AINTS1.peaks <- read.table("anti-CTCF.INTS1+aux_2_frag.bedgraph", sep="\t")[,1:3]
BINTS1.peaks <- read.table("anti-CTCF.INTS1+aux_3_frag.bedgraph", sep="\t")[,1:3]
colnames(AINTS1.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(BINTS1.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
AINTS1.peaks <- GRanges(AINTS1.peaks)
BINTS1.peaks <- GRanges(BINTS1.peaks)
MINTS1.peaks <- intersect(AINTS1.peaks, BINTS1.peaks)

all.peaks <- union(union(UT.peaks, MINTS1.peaks), MINTS11.peaks)
print("Completed")
```

``` {r}
# prep blacklist and chromosome restriction
blacklist <- read.table("hg38-blacklist.v2.bed", sep="\t")
colnames(blacklist) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
blacklist <- GRanges(blacklist)
standard.chr <- paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y"))
param <- readParam(max.frag=1000, pe="both", discard=blacklist, restrict=standard.chr)
print("Completed")
```

```{r}
# load and count reads from bam files
pe.bams <- c(
  "anti-CTCF.INTS1-aux_1.sorted.bam",
  "anti-CTCF.INTS1-aux_2.sorted.bam",
  #"anti-CTCF.INTS1-aux_3.sorted.bam",
  "anti-CTCF.INTS11+aux_1.sorted.bam",
  "anti-CTCF.INTS11+aux_2.sorted.bam",
  "anti-CTCF.INTS1+aux_2.sorted.bam",
  "anti-CTCF.INTS1+aux_3.sorted.bam"
)
peak.counts <- regionCounts(pe.bams, all.peaks, param=param)
peak.abundances <- aveLogCPM(asDGEList(peak.counts))
peak.counts.filt <- peak.counts[peak.abundances > -3, ]


# generate window counts (NOTE: MAYBE CHANGE CONSTANT VALUES?)
counts <- windowCounts(pe.bams, width=300, param=param)
neighbor <- suppressWarnings(resize(rowRanges(counts), width=2000, fix="center"))
wider <- regionCounts(pe.bams, regions=neighbor, param=param)
filter.stat <- filterWindowsLocal(counts, wider)
counts.local.filt <- counts[filter.stat$filter > log2(3),]
print("Completed")
```

```{r}
# MACS TMM normalization
binned <- windowCounts(pe.bams, bin=TRUE, width=10000, param=param)
working.windows <- peak.counts.filt
working.windows <- normFactors(binned, se.out=working.windows)
```

```{r}
# setup design matrix
y <- asDGEList(working.windows)
colnames(y$counts) <- c(
  "AUT", "BUT", #"CUT",
  "AINTS11", "BINTS11",
  "AINTS1", "BINTS1"
)
rownames(y$samples) <- c(
  "AUT", "BUT", #"CUT",
  "AINTS11", "BINTS11",
  "AINTS1", "BINTS1"
)
y$samples$group <- c(
  "UT", "UT", #"UT",
  "MINTS11", "MINTS11",
  "MINTS1", "MINTS1"
)
design <- model.matrix(~0+group, data=y$samples)
print(design)
colnames(design) <- c("UT", "MINTS11", "MINTS1")
print("Completed")
```

```{r}
# differential accessibility testing
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmFit(y, design)
lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = 2)
csaw_deg_table <- as.data.frame(topTags(lrt, n = nrow(y), sort.by = 'PValue'))
csaw_deg_table <- csaw_deg_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = rownames(csaw_deg_table),
                type = ifelse(FDR < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1.0, 'significant', 'not significant')) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR, type)
fig_ma <- csaw_deg_table %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logCPM, y = logFC, color = type)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#666666', '#d62728'))
print(fig_ma)
```

```{r}

qlf <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust=TRUE)
# # MINTS11 v MINTS1
qlft <- glmQLFTest(qlf, contrast=makeContrasts(UT-MINTS1, levels=design))


rowData(working.windows) <- cbind(rowData(working.windows), qlft$table)
merged.peaks <- mergeWindows(rowRanges(working.windows), tol=500L, max.width=5000L)
tab.best <- getBestTest(merged.peaks$id, qlft$table)
final.merged.peaks <- merged.peaks$region
final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata <- cbind(final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata, tab.best[, -1])
final.merged.peaks <- final.merged.peaks[order(final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata$FDR), ]
final.merged.peaks.sig <- final.merged.peaks[final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata$FDR < 0.05, ]


# generate plot
final.merged.peaks$sig <- "n.s"
final.merged.peaks$sig[final.merged.peaks$FDR < 0.05] <- "significant"
# ...
test_df <- as.data.frame(final.merged.peaks)[sample(nrow(as.data.frame(final.merged.peaks)), 15000), ]
test_df$sig <- "n.s"
test_df$sig[test_df$FDR < 0.05] <- "significant"
# ...
ggplot(data=data.frame(test_df),
       aes(x = rep.test, y = rep.logFC, col = sig)) +
    geom_point() + scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +
    geom_smooth(inherit.aes = F, aes(x = rep.test, y = rep.logFC), method = "loess") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + labs(col = NULL)
```

```{r}

# differences between G and V annotation
annotated_final_merged_peaks <- annotatePeak(
  final.merged.peaks[final.merged.peaks$FDR < 0.05],
  TxDb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
)
plotAnnoPie(annotated_final_merged_peaks)

annotated_final_merged_peaks_df <- as.data.frame(annotated_final_merged_peaks)


# pull promoter peaks
promoter_de_peaks <- annotated_final_merged_peaks_df[grepl("Promoter", annotated_final_merged_peaks_df$annotation, fixed=TRUE),]
higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks <- promoter_de_peaks[promoter_de_peaks$FDR < 0.00001, ]
head(higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks[order(higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks$seqnames, higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks$start), ])
MINTS1_biased_promoter_de_peaks <- higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks[higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks$direction == "up", ]
MINTS11_biased_promoter_de_peaks <- higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks[higher_confidence_promoter_de_peaks$direction == "down", ]

# save promoter peaks to bed

                              starts=MINTS1_biased_promoter_de_peaks$start-1,
                              ends=MINTS1_biased_promoter_de_peaks$end,
                              names=c(rep(".", length(MINTS1_biased_promoter_de_peaks$strand))),
                              scores=c(rep(".", length(MINTS1_biased_promoter_de_peaks$strand))),
                              strands=MINTS1_biased_promoter_de_peaks$strand)
write.table(
  MINTS1_promoter_bed_df,
  file="csaw_edgeR_diff_accessible_MINTS1_biased_peaks_by_promoters.bed",
```

``` {r}
# Trying out just promoters I care about
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)  # if reading BED


# Convert the peak data.frame to GRanges
peaks_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = df_mints11$seqnames,
  ranges = IRanges(start = df_mints11$start, end = df_mints11$end),
  strand = "*",  # CUT&RUN peaks usually aren't strand-specific
  direction = df_mints11$direction
)

# Read the gene list BED file (6-column BED)
genes <- rtracklayer::import("all_genes.bed")

# Get the TSS location based on strand
tss <- resize(genes, width = 1, fix = ifelse(strand(genes) == "+", "start", "end"))

# Extend ±1kb around TSS
tss_window <- resize(tss, width = 2001, fix = "center")

# Keep only peaks with "up" or "down" direction
peaks_gr <- peaks_gr[peaks_gr$direction %in% c("up", "down")]

# Find overlaps
hits <- findOverlaps(peaks_gr, tss_window)

# Add metadata column for in/out of TSS window
peaks_gr$in_tss_window <- FALSE
peaks_gr[queryHits(hits)]$in_tss_window <- TRUE


```

``` {r}
############
# Begin Volcano Plots
############

# GRanges -> dataframe and annotate

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

prepare_volcano_df <- function(gr, comparison_name) {
  df <- as.data.frame(gr)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(gene_type = case_when(
      rep.logFC >= 1 & PValue <= 0.01 ~ "up",
      rep.logFC <= -1 & PValue <= 0.01 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FoldChange = rep.logFC,
      pval = PValue,
      Comparison = comparison_name
    )
  return(df)
}

# Create data frames
df_mints1_vs_ctl <- prepare_volcano_df(final.merged.peaks_mints1, "MINTS1 vs CTL")
df_mints11_vs_ctl <- prepare_volcano_df(final.merged.peaks_mints11, "MINTS11 vs CTL")
#df_mints1_vs_mints11 <- prepare_volcano_df(final.merged.peaks_m1vm11, "MINTS1 vs MINTS11")
```

``` {r}

##################
# Volcano plot function
##################

make_volcano_plot <- function(df, title, outfile) {
  cols <- c("up" = "red", "down" = "blue", "ns" = "grey")
  sizes <- c("up" = 2, "down" = 2, "ns" = 1)
  alphas <- c("up" = 1, "down" = 1, "ns" = 0.5)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pval))) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = gene_type, size = gene_type, alpha = gene_type),
               shape = 21, colour = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.01), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_size_manual(values = sizes) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5), xlim = c(-7.5, 7.5)) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "log2(fold change)",
         y = "-log10(P-value)") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )

  ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p, width = 12, height = 9)
  return(p)
}

```

```{r}
#######################
# Diff binding using merged bam files
#######################

union_peaks <- rtracklayer::import("union_peaks_ctl_vs_ints1.bed")

bam_files <- c(
  "CTCF_INTS1-aux_sorted.bam",
  "CTCF_INTS1+aux_NoRep1_sort.bam"
)

blacklist <- rtracklayer::import("hg38-blacklist.v2.bed")
standard_chr <- paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y"))

# Read parameters
param <- readParam(
  max.frag = 1000,
  pe = "both",
  discard = blacklist,
  restrict = standard_chr
)

peak_counts <- regionCounts(bam_files, regions = union_peaks, param = param)
```

```{r}
#assay(peak_counts)       # raw counts matrix
rowRanges(peak_counts)   # peak coordinates
colData(peak_counts)     # sample metadata
y <- asDGEList(peak_counts)
colnames(y) <- c("CTL", "INTS1")
```

```{r}
# TMM normalization
y$samples$group <- c("CTL", "INTS1")
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
```

```{r}
# log2 calculations
logCPM <- cpm(y, log = TRUE)
log2FC <- logCPM[, "INTS1"] - logCPM[, "CTL"]
peak_df <- as.data.frame(rowRanges(peak_counts))
peak_df$log2FC <- log2FC

# classify direction
peak_df$direction <- ifelse(peak_df$log2FC > 1, "up",
                            ifelse(peak_df$log2FC < -1, "down", "unchanged"))

# output
write.table(peak_df, "log2fc_peaks_ctl_vs_ints1.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

``` {r}
df <- read.table("log2fc_peaks_ctl_vs_ints1.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Convert to GRanges
peaks_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = df$seqnames,
  ranges = IRanges(start = df$start, end = df$end),
  strand = "*",
  direction = df$direction
)

# Keep only directional peaks
peaks_gr <- peaks_gr[peaks_gr$direction %in% c("up", "down")]

```

```{r}
# Load 6-column BED of promoters of interest
genes <- import("all_genes.bed")

# Get strand-aware TSS
tss <- resize(genes, width = 1, fix = ifelse(strand(genes) == "+", "start", "end"))

tss_window <- resize(tss, width = 2001, fix = "center")

# Find overlaps
hits <- findOverlaps(peaks_gr, tss_window)

# Add in/out TSS window annotation
peaks_gr$in_tss_window <- FALSE
peaks_gr[queryHits(hits)]$in_tss_window <- TRUE

# Convert to data.frame
peaks_df <- as.data.frame(peaks_gr)

# Count by region and direction
counts <- dplyr::count(peaks_df, in_tss_window, direction)

# Label regions
counts$region <- ifelse(counts$in_tss_window, "±1kb of TSS", "Elsewhere")
```

```{r}
ggplot(counts, aes(x = region, y = n, fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(
    title = "CTCF Peak Directionality Around TSS",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Number of Peaks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("up" = "#1b9e77", "down" = "#d95f02"))
```

```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)

# Load gene list
genes <- import("all_genes.bed")
tss <- resize(genes, width = 1, fix = ifelse(strand(genes) == "+", "start", "end"))
window <- resize(tss, width = 4001, fix = "center")

# Load CTCF motif sites
ctcf <- import("ctcfSites.hg38.bed")

# Find overlaps
hits <- findOverlaps(ctcf, window)
ctcf_near_genes <- ctcf[queryHits(hits)]

# Export to BED
export(ctcf_near_genes, "ctcf_near_genes.bed")


```
